info.title: OrenjiTrade API
info.description: REST API of OrenjiTrade, the geographic discovery network for trading cards. Generated from the Spring Boot application by `./gradlew exportOpenApi` (apps/api). Do not edit by hand.

tags.name: internal
tags.description: Internal job triggers (service token / Google OIDC)

tags.name: location
tags.description: Approximate trading area and public map position

tags.name: account
tags.description: Data export and account deletion of the caller

tags.name: profile
tags.description: The caller's public profile, avatar and tags

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Privacy and notification settings of the caller

get.description: Defaults favour safety: not discoverable, online status hidden, profile visible to members, messages from members with a profile, wishlist hidden.

put.description: Full replacement (every field required). Switching `discoverable` on derives the public map point from the trading area; switching it off removes the collector from the map immediately.

get.description: Defaults: push and in-app on, email off, MARKETING fully off.

put.description: Full replacement. Unknown categories, malformed times (HH:mm) and unknown time zones are 400.

get.description: Returns defaults derived from the account (handle, display name) until the profile is saved for the first time.

put.description: Full replacement of handle, display name, bio, games and languages. 400 for unknown games (yugioh, pokemon, mtg, riftbound), non ISO 639-1 languages or blocked terms; 409 HANDLE_TAKEN when the handle is used (case-insensitive) or reserved. The first save completes the `profileComplete` onboarding step.

At most 12 tags in total. `tagIds` must be active tags; `customLabels` (2-24 characters) are checked against the banned-term rules and created as CUSTOM tags (or matched to an existing tag with the same slug). Returns the resulting tags.
Radius 1-50 km, latitude within +/-85. The server snaps the centre to a ~1 km grid cell and offsets it with a deterministic per-user jitter to derive `publicPoint` (3 decimals) and its region label.

put.summary: Replace the roles of an account (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
put.description: USER is always kept. Only a SUPER_ADMIN may grant or revoke ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, and nobody can remove their own SUPER_ADMIN. Audited.

post.description: Records a `ping` job run and answers `{ "ok": true }`.
Anonymises every account whose grace period is over, purges module data, deletes the identity-provider user and records a job run. Consents, audit entries and ledgers are kept.

Multipart part `file`: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB (type sniffed from the content). The server cover-crops it to a 512x512 square and re-encodes it without any metadata (EXIF/GPS stripped). 413 above 5 MB, 415 for other types, 400 for unreadable images. Rate-limited (10 per hour).

get.description: Newest first; lets clients find the pending request to cancel it after a reload.

post.summary: Request the deletion of the caller's account
post.description: Needs an ID token whose `auth_time` is at most 5 minutes old (401 REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED otherwise). On success the account becomes DELETION_REQUESTED, every identity-provider session is revoked (signed out everywhere; signing in again only gives access to GET /me, GET /me/export and these deletion endpoints), the collector disappears from the map and the deletion runs after a 7-day grace period. 409 DELETION_BLOCKED (extension `blockers[]`) while obligations are open; 409 CONFLICT when a request is already pending.
Stores the version, timestamp, a salted hash of the client IP and the user agent. 409 when the version is not the current one.
409 when the account is not suspended. Audited.
Blocks every API call of the account (403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED) and disables the identity-provider user. Audited.

get.description: Active tags whose label or slug contains `query` (case and accent insensitive), prefix matches first, then the most used. Without `query`: the most used tags. Rate-limited (60 per minute).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Substring of the label or slug

get.description: Serves an object of the media storage by key (for example `avatars/<user id>/<random>.jpg`). Immutable: cache for a year.
Provisions the account on the first call. Exempt from the terms-acceptance check so clients can discover `requiredConsents`.
Cheapest authenticated call: refreshes the caller's last-active timestamp and is subject to the terms-acceptance check like every other route.

get.summary: The caller's trading area and public point
get.description: The only endpoint that returns the caller's chosen centre. `publicPoint` is what other collectors see and is null while not discoverable.

delete.description: Deletes every location row; the collector disappears from the map.

get.description: JSON document with one section per module (account + consents, profile + tags + privacy settings, notification preferences, trading area, ...). Served as an attachment. Rate-limited (10 per hour); also available while a deletion is pending.

Handle lookup is case-insensitive. 404 when the account does not exist, is suspended, pending deletion or deleted, or when the profile is PRIVATE (for everyone but its owner). `location` is null unless the collector is discoverable; `distanceBucket` needs a trading area on the caller's side and `showDistance` on the collector's. Coordinates are the derived public point only (3 decimals).

200.description: Public profile as seen by the caller

get.description: Newest first. `query` matches handle, email and display name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of handle, email or display name

get.description: Account, roles, consents, public location label (never coordinates), pending deletion request and recent audit entries.
Newest first. Every filter is optional; `from` is inclusive, `to` exclusive.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending deletion during the grace period
delete.description: Re-activates the account (and its map presence). 404 when the request is not the caller's, 409 when it is no longer pending.

discoverable.description: Appear on the map / in nearby searches (default false)

categories.description: Channels per category; categories left out get their defaults (MARKETING is off unless explicitly enabled)

handle.description: 3-24 characters [a-z0-9_] (input is trimmed and lower-cased); unique case-insensitively; reserved words refused (409 HANDLE_TAKEN)

profileComplete.description: Whether the profile was saved at least once

usageCount.description: Number of profiles carrying the tag

customLabels.description: Free labels (2-24 characters, banned-term check); created as CUSTOM tags or matched to an existing tag with the same slug

source.description: MANUAL (default) or DEVICE; DEVICE only records where the centre came from, the server still snaps it

publicPoint.description: The derived point other collectors see; null while not discoverable

PublicPoint.description: Approximate public position (about 1 km grid + deterministic jitter, 3 decimals); never the collector's real location

TradingAreaResponse.description: Trading area chosen by the owner

roles.description: Complete role set; USER is always kept

skipped.description: Due requests cancelled or taken meanwhile

failed.description: Requests left pending after an error

reason.description: Optional free text; never copied into the audit log

exportFirst.description: The owner wants their export first; GET /me/export stays available while the deletion is pending

scheduledFor.description: End of the grace period (requestedAt + 7 days)

blockers.description: Always empty on an accepted request (blocked ones are 409)

ConsentRequest.description: Acceptance of one legal document version

until.description: End of the suspension; null for indefinite

requiredConsents.description: Current legal document versions still to accept; while non-empty every non-exempt route answers 428

OnboardingStatus.description: Which onboarding steps the user completed

RequiredConsent.description: A legal document version that must be accepted

distanceBucket.description: Null unless the caller has a trading area and the collector shows distances

location.description: Null unless the collector is discoverable

canMessage.description: Whether the caller may start a conversation

AdminUserSummary.description: Account as listed in the admin console

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages

AdminUserDetail.description: Account detail for the admin console

locationLabel.description: Public trading-area label; coordinates are never exposed

id.description: Acting account id; absent for SYSTEM actions

handle.description: Handle of the acting account when it still exists

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details with OrenjiTrade extensions

blockers.description: Open obligations preventing an account deletion (DELETION_BLOCKED), e.g. OPEN_DISPUTE

serviceToken.description: Shared service token for /internal/** (alternative: a Google OIDC bearer token)
serviceToken.name: X-Service-Token
